questions.question: What is the significance of the discovery of Coelacanth in 1938?
questions.answer: In 1938, 1958, Coelacanth was caught in a lake in South Africa after it was thought to have become extinct. They are also called lobefins & they evolved to become fish & first amphibians that lived in waters & also on land. We have no specimens of these left today.

questions.question: What are interferons and their role in the immune system?
questions.answer: The interferons are a part of cytokine barrier. They are released by virus infected cells to protect the normal cells from further viral infection. They are also used in the treatment of cancer.

Where do the signals of parturition originate in mammals?
questions.answer: The signals of parturition originate from fully developed foetus and the placenta of the female.
